items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I worked with Eddie Johnson with the -- Merle Young's band at the Rum Boogie, during the war.

ctx.x: Is that Eddie Johnson, the tenor man?
No, Eddie Johnson never worked with us. I worked with Eddie Johnson with the -- Merle Young's band at the Rum Boogie, during the war.
Is there anything that you've regretted over the course of your career?
